items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, they were singing, Clark Yokum, Hal Hopper and one other, and June Hutton, were the Pied Pipers, during those years.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I think that's what it says. '44, yeah. Yeah, they were singing, Clark Yokum, Hal Hopper and one other, and June Hutton, were the Pied Pipers, during those years.
I wasn't aware that June had ever been with the Pied Pipers.
